rows.name:
Dodora likes all things High Entia; that's why he
wants to make a headdress from their feathers
he found in Achamoth. Care to lend him a hand?
Collect 5 [System:Color name=item ]High Entia Feathers[/System:Color] in Achamoth.

Dodora was overjoyed by the feathers you brought
him. The headdress is sure to be interesting...
